dictionary.flow_empty_text: Ask {{assistant}} a question from the dock: the graph builds in real time showing memory, laws, consensus verdicts, ReAct loops and returns.
dictionary.ri_loading: Reading the real behaviour from the code…
dictionary.ri_honest: Every number below is read live from the code that answers your questions: parameters, models, formulas and current state.
dictionary.ri_route_chat: With a {{sla}} ms target (≤ {{limit}} ms) the question goes to the fast model chain, in this order:
dictionary.ri_route_deep: With a {{sla}} ms target (above {{limit}} ms) the question goes to the deep model chain, in this order:
dictionary.ri_no_models: No model configured for this chain.
dictionary.ri_auto_desc: For each question it computes complexity (words ÷ {{words}}, max 1) and checks the rules in order: the first true one wins.
dictionary.ri_words_label: Try it: words in the question
dictionary.ri_f_budget: Branches allowed by the current emotional state
dictionary.ri_f_budget_stress: With cortisol > 0.8 branches drop to a quarter.
dictionary.ri_f_budget_explore: More dopamine and serotonin = more branches explored, never above the profile maximum.
dictionary.ri_f_lanes_why: Each branch is a candidate model (local models count as one): no more branches than available candidates.
dictionary.ri_f_critic: Simulated critic (predicted impact on the user)
dictionary.ri_f_ignite: The first branch above the threshold wins and stops the others
dictionary.ri_f_prune: A branch stops if a step is too low
dictionary.ri_f_fallback: When time runs out the best branch found is used; if none produced text, models are asked one after another.
dictionary.ri_limbic_desc: Emotional modulator values used in the calculations above. No real sensor changes them today, so they stay at their starting values.
